newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 11 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 11 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 11 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Crossett S.D. No. 52, Ark., $3.695 million refunding bonds.
--Minneapolis Special School District No.1, Minn., $47.4 million school building GOs.
--Rotterdam CSD, N.Y., $2.37 million school district bonds.
--Philipsburg Area School District, Pa., $7 million GOs under the alternate bidding program.
--Park City School District, Utah, school building GOs
--Virginia Housing Development, Va., $32.8 million revenue bonds and $25.8 million AMT revenue bonds.
